import bpy, os, json, urllib.parse, urllib.request, time
expected=os.path.normcase(os.path.normpath(r'C:\\mcp-blender\\salvador_lacerda_do_zero.blend'))
if os.path.normcase(os.path.normpath(bpy.data.filepath))!=expected:
    raise RuntimeError(f'ABORTADO arquivo errado {bpy.data.filepath!r}')
ROOT='https://geo.salvador.ba.gov.br/arcgis/rest/services'
def gj(url,params=None,timeout=18):
    if params: url += ('&' if '?' in url else '?')+urllib.parse.urlencode(params)
    req=urllib.request.Request(url,headers={'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0'})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=timeout) as r: return json.loads(r.read().decode('utf-8','replace'))
root=gj(ROOT,{'f':'json'})
print('ROOT_FOLDERS',json.dumps(root.get('folders') or [],ensure_ascii=False))
print('ROOT_SERVICES',json.dumps(root.get('services') or [],ensure_ascii=False,separators=(',',':')))
folders=['']+list(root.get('folders') or [])
all_services=[]
for folder in folders:
    url=ROOT+('/'+urllib.parse.quote(folder,safe='') if folder else '')
    try: d=gj(url,{'f':'json'})
    except Exception as e: print('FOLDER_ERR',folder,type(e).__name__,str(e)[:120]); continue
    sv=d.get('services') or []
    print('FOLDER',folder or '<root>','SERVICES',len(sv),'SUBFOLDERS',json.dumps(d.get('folders') or [],ensure_ascii=False))
    for s in sv:
        name=s.get('name',''); typ=s.get('type','')
        all_services.append((name,typ))
print('ALL_SERVICES',len(all_services))
name_terms=('altim','curva','nivel','nível','cota','topo','mdt','mde','dem','dtm','lidar','laser','relevo','hipso','batim','sicad','cartog','cadast','base','terreno','centro','plano')
candidates=[]
for name,typ in all_services:
    low=name.lower()
    if any(t in low for t in name_terms): candidates.append((name,typ,'NAME'))
print('NAME_CANDIDATES',len(candidates))
for c in candidates: print('CANDIDATE',json.dumps(c,ensure_ascii=False))
# Inspeciona metadados dos candidatos por nome e também todos os MapServer/FeatureServer até limite razoável, buscando nomes de camadas.
layer_terms=('altim','curva','nivel','nível','cota','topog','mdt','mde','dem','dtm','lidar','laser','relevo','hipso','batim','sicad','cartog','terreno')
seen=set(); layer_hits=[]; inspected=0
ordered=candidates + [(n,t,'SCAN') for n,t in all_services if (n,t,'NAME') not in candidates and t in ('MapServer','FeatureServer')]
for name,typ,why in ordered[:700]:
    key=(name,typ)
    if key in seen: continue
    seen.add(key)
    url=ROOT+'/'+urllib.parse.quote(name,safe='/')+'/'+typ
    try: m=gj(url,{'f':'json'},timeout=12)
    except Exception: continue
    inspected+=1
    layers=m.get('layers') or []
    for l in layers:
        lname=str(l.get('name') or '')
        if any(t in lname.lower() for t in layer_terms):
            layer_hits.append({'service':name,'type':typ,'url':url,'layer_id':l.get('id'),'layer_name':lname})
    if why=='NAME':
        print('CANDIDATE_META',json.dumps({'service':name,'type':typ,'url':url,'description':m.get('serviceDescription') or m.get('description'),'spatialReference':m.get('spatialReference'),'fullExtent':m.get('fullExtent'),'layers':[{'id':l.get('id'),'name':l.get('name')} for l in layers[:100]]},ensure_ascii=False,separators=(',',':')))
print('INSPECTED',inspected,'LAYER_HITS',len(layer_hits))
for h in layer_hits[:250]: print('LAYER_HIT',json.dumps(h,ensure_ascii=False,separators=(',',':')))
print('ARCGIS_SERVICE_CRAWL_DONE')
